name: agents-discipline
description: Agents Discipline & Good Project Management for Claude Code. Bootstraps CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md (for OpenAI Codex adversarial review), INDEX.md, specs/, .claude/hooks, rules, output-styles and permission allowlists — the quiet files that keep agents honest. Also installs and runs a Codex council of native subagents (REVIEW or BUILD mode) with a blind Claude reviewer and a process auditor.
